financial_anchor.caveat: Reported/adjusted measures differ; cycle, mix and capital intensity confound.

ai_claim.claim: MercadoLibre deployed GitHub Copilot across its developer organization; GitHub reports coding time cut 50%, while MELI reports code submissions up 90%, without matched quality or cash controls.
ai_claim.stage: E2 named enterprise developer deployment in opened supplier/customer material; no E3/E4
ai_claim.scope: Specific workflow only; infrastructure demand is separated from own productivity.
ai_claim.limitation: No representative controlled cohort or retained-cash reconciliation.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: Q2 operating margin was only 6.7% despite 50% revenue growth.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Does not itself disprove the scoped mechanism.

rights_limit: Public terms do not prove universal training or pooled cross-customer reuse; enterprise schedules were unavailable.
materiality_summary: Framework convention: $136.6m = 5% × (4 × $683m Q2 reported operating income). Illustrative cost assumptions produce negative $40m; not a forecast.
